notes.title: If you saw Ruiner and thought it would be cool in first-person, its developer is back with, you guessed it, an FPS
notes.notes: There's one round little chubster robot with an exposed core, so I yank it out of his chest and he drops immediately. I could throw it like a grenade, but instead I absorb it to earn a brief superpunch power-up that I use to launch myself at one of the heavier-armored robots, bashing the metal plates right off him. While I'm up close and he's staggered I switch to shotgun to finish him off, then jetpack away. There's a bunch more robot enemies in this arena, and I saw some ammo up on the wallrun I could reach while I wait for the core-yanking ability to come back online... Read more.

notes.title: Metal Eden (PC) Review
notes.notes:
Metal Eden is what happens when Doom meets Cyberpunk with a splash of Metal Gear Solid and Metroid thrown in for good measure.

Metal Eden is a standout title that blends old-school sensibilities with gorgeous modern graphics in a concise and action-packed single-player experience. In other words, if you’re a fan of the boomer shooter genre or have an affinity for old-school first-person shooters, Metal Eden is worth your time.

As a big fan of Ruiner, I was excited to see how Reikon Games could translate their stellar futurist isometric aesthetic to a proper 3D FPS game. I’m happy to say that Metal Eden carries the torch, while bringing with it a more vibrant gamut of colours, with levels soaked in neon RGB goodness that goes beyond the mostly monochromatic world of Ruiner.

If you have a beefy enough rig, Metal Eden’s in-game graphics can nearly match the pre-rendered cutscenes that add exposition between missions, making it one of the best-looking games... Read more

notes.title: Metal Eden Demo Patch 0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Hyper Units,[/h3]
We've just released the first patch for the demo on [b]Steam[/b]!
This update addresses several of the most frequently reported issues based on your feedback. Thanks so much for taking the time to share your thoughts with us.
Some issues – like shader-related stuttering – are still on our radar and will be tackled in the next patch. We appreciate your patience as we continue improving the experience!

[b]Note: This update will wipe all existing save files due to system changes.[/b]

[b]Key Highlights[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Motion Blur toggle in Video Settings.
[*] New options for [b]Mouse Acceleration[/b] and [b]Controller Acceleration[/b] are now available in the Options Menu.
[/list]
[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] General optimization passes applied, resulting in improved performance in [i]CRASH COURSE[/i] and [i]PARADISE LOST[/i]
[*] Added support for Hardware RTX and introduced a Framerate Limit setting
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated audio mix for enemy sound effects, UI feedback, and player weapons.
[*] Final cutscene audio added for [i]CRASH COURSE[/i].
[*] Replaced an old VO line for Nexus in [i]CRASH COURSE[/i] with a new one.
[*] Improved dialogue system to ensure proper voiceover triggering.
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*] Translation fixes applied across various languages.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading screen cutscenes wouldn't always play when starting a mission.
[*] Subtitle settings now correctly apply to loading screen cutscenes.
[*] Added an "Apply Settings" button in the Options Menu.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved respawn issues after falling off the map in [i]PARADISE LOST[/i].
[*] Fixed collision bugs across multiple maps.
[*] Fixed the quest objective "Find Defunct Hyper Unit" completing prematurely after the core tutorial.
[*] Corrected objective marker placement at the end of [i]CRASH COURSE[/i].
[*] Adjusted timing in the Core Tutorial to potentially fix the infinite slow-mo bug.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues – Targeted for Next Patch 0.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Further improvements to game stability
[*] Options menu needs a clearer layout and improved usability.
[*] Cutscene audio is too quiet and requires proper mastering.
[*] Further optimization is needed to improve overall performance.
[*] Weapon sounds and music lack impact; audio mix will be refined.
[*] Gamepad keybinding support is currently missing and will be added.
[*] Additional improvements to overall rendering quality are in progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve decided to move the release of METAL EDEN to Summer 2025. 

After going through the feedback from the demo, we saw some clear areas where we can improve. We’re taking a bit more time to refine the game and make sure it delivers the experience we’re aiming for. Your input has been a big part of that process, and we appreciate it.

We know delays aren’t ideal, and we really appreciate your patience. We’ll share the new date as soon as we can—and we’re confident it’ll be worth the wait.

Thanks for sticking with us. 
More soon.

The METAL EDEN Team

notes.title: Who is ASKA?
notes.notes:
HYPER UNITS, CONFIRM YOUR STATUS 

ASKA is an advanced hyper unit built upon a digitized human psyche, designed to save and protect humanity from the captivity of the Engineers. 

She is the first human whose core is built on the revolutionary streaming technology, allowing her to stream her consciousness back to NEXUS when her body experiences failure to be rebuilt and try again. Making her the perfect machine for the mission. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/58a408be85496035d967dd85e4a97712dad8ab6e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/0cad307f48dd3fb38ecd875b06f2c294efa51f2c.png[/img]
Humanity has been trapped at the centre of MOEBIUS, inside the HIVE. ASKA’s mission is to infiltrate MOEBIUS and get past the cleaners, commanded by the Engineers to stop her. And free Humanity from the HIVE, located at the centre of the city. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/8d04ce177cd1e6561a188c50538ccde71b13953c.png[/img]
Built for the mission to save humanity, ASKA has been equipped with a wide range of powerful tools. One of those is Core Ripping, which allows her to extract the cores of unprotected enemies. 

Extracting the core from an enemy will immediately neutralize them, giving you multiple options for how to use the core. 

Consuming the core will allow her to extract the energy from it, providing ASKA with a significant power boost. Also let her perform a Super Punch that can send enemies flying, or deal a significant amount of damage to armored enemies. 

If surrounded by enemies she can throw the core, causing an explosion dealing devastating damage to surrounding foes, and depending on your upgrades can cause different status effects to them. 

Using Core Ripping it’s additionally possible to gain a boost in Healing and Armor to quickly recover health and her defenses, ensuring she can withstand the toughest of foes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/168064c46f9ab8987137dd5f391abc6cce32db5f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/56310a4d8126f9ccd9c36d94222876f5e70e6e31.png[/img]
Periodically throughout the game, ASKA will come across Body Modules allowing her to upgrade her own core’s capability and increase the effectiveness of Core Ripping. The different upgrades available to ASKA through body modules is 

[b]Core Power Path:[/b] Focuses on explosive energy and high-damage attacks.  

[b]Body Suit Upgrades:[/b] Enhances mobility, and defence, and slows time for precise attacks.  

[b]Core Ripping Enhancements:[/b] Boosts efficiency, allowing ASKA to extract more power from her enemies.  

Allowing her to tailor her abilities depending on how she wants to fight the Cleaners and Engineers in her way. 

Different upgrade combinations will affect ASKA’s combat efficiency in different ways. Some different combinations would be: 

[b]High Damage:[/b] Iron Fist + Double Punch  

[b]Agility & Precision:[/b] Combat Focus Mode + Synaptic Suppression  

[b]Core Ripping Mastery:[/b] Magnetic Field + Core Eruption  

Getting high damage with iron fist to increase super punch range and radius, and double punch to punch twice for each core consumption. 

Using Combat focus mode to slow time on command, and synaptic suppression to make you take less damage in slow motion to create precision both in shooting and movement. 

Or master core ripping by doubling the extraction radius with magnetic field, and causing an explosion using Core eruption. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/302b41154e53f9df7c0265bdb384703f990e19f2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/5204215cf01515e7857b258f0ec6e61f2b0f8169.png[/img]
Being able to upgrade your Core isn’t the only way ASKA will improve throughout her mission. During each mission, she will be collecting Dust which can be used to upgrade her weapons based on her needs. 

These upgrades range from simply increasing the capability of each weapon to completely changing how the weapon behaves and how to use it the best. Her pistol can be upgraded to either be able to fire lasers at the enemy dealing high amounts of energy damage, or give the pistol homing capabilities to shoot around corners and never miss a shot. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/80aaeec69befa256936ee06aadb97395b914ed8d.png[/img]
When fighting the army of Cleaners, it’s important to stay on your toes to avoid getting hit by the enemies. While ASKA is immortal, and will always return using the streaming technology her body is not invincible. 

Therefore ASKA has been made capable of creating distance between her and her enemies to protect her body from harm. Dash, Wall run, Zip-line and hover to dodge incoming enemy fire, and stay at a distance from melee specialized cleaners. 

Using these tools makes her a Hyper Unit nearly impossible to hit and catch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/d7adf61a160c3339c787a3def41f5cee76385eb9.png[/img]
Interested in trying METAL EDEN? Wishlist the game on Steam and Join us when the official Demo goes live on April 8th and unleash your Hyper Power upon the Cleaners.

notes.title: Enemy Showcase
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/990380/METAL_EDEN/

[list] [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5ThOT_TR8J4][b]WATCH ENEMY SHOWCASE VIDEO HERE[/b][/url]

HYPER UNITS, CONFIRM YOUR STATUS 

The engineers have sent their cleaners out to stop you. To prepare you for your mission we have gathered some battlefield intel on the enemies you will encounter. 

Keep yourself up to date on these blogs to be in the best position to succeed. 

We were unable to obtain data on some enemies, but further investigations will have to be performed to complete the list. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/43e64badf4ee10e79518620498710834ab92c2ab.png[/img]
[list]Enemies in METAL EDEN are categorized here to better get an understanding of their threat levels. All cleaners have their weak spots, make sure to hit them where it hurts. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/969bba5b7cd3770ed4a22d95aa2fa07a46264f9d.png[/img]
[list]These are the lowest threat level, while the enemies here are easier to handle than the others they’re not to be taken lightly. A few hits from any enemies will leave you damaged. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/030b93717020d68b8b8a1078814a52ad00aa8449.png[/img]
[list]Scrappers, these pesky things are everywhere. Quickly deal with them to avoid having too many enemies after you at once, or take advantage of them not having a shield to take their core and use it to control the battle. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/b7dec8b17320e4e26fe13a39acd7643cd036c647.png[/img]
[list]This is most likely the first armoured enemy the Engineers will send after you. A quick punch will leave it out of balance and make it easier to break its barriers. After you are through its barriers it doesn’t take much to defeat. But be careful as they explode after being damaged. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/9ff2b8a4ea9e0da6cdfecc1623df1750ce0ce193.png[/img]
[list]The basic enemy unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), will follow you and shoot you from above. These airborne gunners make it difficult to dodge and hide from attacks. We recommend dealing with these enemies swiftly to avoid taking unnecessary damage. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/fab089ddc0b9202e9fe93d4dd1a3fc085d4494da.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/09df5270d28b558e325649f7a2db13e165b6adac.png[/img]
[list]Do not let slashers get close. You have been equipped with thrusters to dash and wall-run to keep your distance from dangerous cleaners like these. Make sure to use this to keep your distance. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/cfa06e69486f625634c3ced027210138f08eace2.png[/img]
[list]Basic ranged cleaners will shoot you from afar. Make sure to always be moving to avoid getting hit by their projectiles. Medium to long-ranged weapons are great for these and aim for their head. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/fc643b3de9e3d0d8ca3947bdfe69b085441adfeb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/7596c01a0472562e2aa9a5229cceab767e962704.png[/img]
[list]They will likely send Leapers after you. These will jump and send out shockwaves during combat. Make sure to not stay on the ground for long and keep your distance as you chip away at their defences. Once their armour has been broken, you will need to deal with them quickly because they are no longer weighed down and so will move faster. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/90eac411a8c8803288563a789075d4899d7d18f6.png[/img]
[list]Our data shows many more enemies not just in the previous threat levels but also with threat levels that go beyond ELITE ENEMIES. And not just the engineers but other defences have been set up to stop you.

We don’t have any more information to share about these, so stay vigilant HYPER UNIT. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/1ed778d729528146ceee55ef4cf7277d5546a828.png[/img]

notes.title: INTRODUCING REIKON GAMES
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/d034b1b80fb0d0daf82c7b79ee09a4dbe3e7b521.png[/img][list]We are thrilled to introduce you to the brilliant minds behind METAL EDEN – REIKON Games. Based in Warsaw, Poland, REIKON Games is an independent creative team and development company known for creating high-end computer and video games. Their specialty lies in artistic action adventures set in haunting science-fiction realities, embracing the cybernetic dimension of life.
REIKON Games first made waves in the gaming world with their critically acclaimed title, RUINER. This game was a testament to their passion and creativity, combining intense gameplay with a unique cyberpunk aesthetic. The success of RUINER has set the stage for their next ambitious project, METAL EDEN.
REIKON Games – 10 Years of Raw Energy. What does that mean? It’s our philosophy: over all these years, they've been through our fair share of storms, discovering what works and what doesn’t, and learning that the most important thing is not being afraid to take risks. They've been on this stage since 2014, when a group of veterans decided to create something that would combine passion, experience, and courage. And that’s how REIKON Games was born.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/2de9fb4339a69d0edd5fdd354d2a8c8d14aeb0ae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/1ed778d729528146ceee55ef4cf7277d5546a828.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/af9474b96440344330e74d3b09a814a98e2ac215.png[/img][list]Our studio is a team of 40 creative people who’ve proven over the years that they know how to create games with real edge. From the cult hit RUINER to the upcoming METAL EDEN – they're all about delivering sharp, high-octane experiences, with a soul. That’s what drives us—our games are real and full of energy, just like a high-intensity performance.
As for the name REIKON? It comes from the word "REIKON," which means soul. It's a reminder of what drives us—our experiences, our past, and our passion for creating something meaningful. They've invited different souls into our lives. Souls of the past, of experiences, of those who showed us how to follow what they believe in. And it’s these ‘souls’ that continue to guide us forward.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/b0d6c95c5a6a347bb9c66d36651a2c7cabd4f809.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/42201599a970bf46bdd7162a2c37366d1d7d9f18.png[/img][list]With METAL EDEN, REIKON Games aims to push the boundaries of cybernetic warfare and deliver an adrenaline-fueled experience like no other. Their goal is to create a game that not only captivates players with its intense gameplay and stunning visuals but also leaves a lasting impact. They want players to immerse themselves in the neon-soaked architecture of a techno planet, uncover the secrets of a lost colony, and experience the thrill of agile combat.
REIKON Games is committed to providing a game that is both challenging and rewarding, allowing players to develop their arsenal and combat abilities to become unstoppable Hyper Units. They believe that METAL EDEN will set a new standard for action-adventure games and are excited to share this journey with their fans.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/8b847108ad651a7a1f85049f6e10da7548815a76.png[/img][list]Stay tuned for more updates and exclusive content about METAL EDEN. We can't wait for you to dive into the world of cybernetic warfare and experience the future of gaming with REIKON Games![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/1ed778d729528146ceee55ef4cf7277d5546a828.png[/img]

notes.title: Metal Eden is a movement-shooter that looks like cyberpunk Doom Eternal
notes.notes: Buried in the onslaught of Sony's State of Play announcements—a scattershot blast of Too Much Videogame I'm still tweezering out pellets of—was the announcement of Metal Eden. Being developed by Polish studio Reikon, who formerly made birdseye action game Ruiner, Metal Eden's only been seen briefly before, back when it was codenamed Final Form... Read more.

notes.title: METAL EDEN Reveal Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/dff004da31250da35db8633460c930b65990e188.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=yM4ZrnWRNTU;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome to the world of METAL EDEN, where cybernetic warfare meets pulse-pounding action! Prepare yourself for an adrenaline-fueled journey as you dive into a hostile artificial world, battling against tough, agile mecha troops and elemental forces.

In METAL EDEN, you will play ASKA, a Hyper Unit android built around a digitized human soul. Your mission is to explore the architecture of a techno planet and the ruins of the world below, uncovering the secrets of Project EDEN and the cybernetic COREs. With your sentient spaceship, Nexus, you'll expand your arsenal and upgrade your undying body, all while uncovering the truth behind this haunting machine world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/1ed778d729528146ceee55ef4cf7277d5546a828.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/4a344cb054e2d3ed676f1a521f90de997c309a1b.png[/img]
[list]Fight a diverse roster of enemies, extracting energy cores to gain a battle zone advantage. Develop your arsenal and combat abilities to become an unstoppable Hyper Unit. Engage in an elegant dance of destruction as you dash, grapple, and wall-run through the city's defenses using enhanced parkour skills. Harness your superior agility and acrobatic combat prowess in pulse-pounding encounters.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/41aeff6dd9820c64eeda792e59b048d34f86b9ad.png[/img]
Transform into an armored Battle Sphere to charge into action and take on deadly foes. Be bold. Be daring. Hurl yourself into the fray and save the COREs in a clash of future visions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/6e2c5e85597c9172130a8ef521508d2600ec4278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/f853837ef463957dfef0ca094bcf040afdb6a989.png[/img]
[list]In METAL EDEN, you can choose a wide range of weapons to match your combat style. You begin with the Hertz Autopistol, an infinite ammo weapon perfect for sustained fire.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/eafb782332d9cd2c85f29c8bdf587fae11244dc3.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Zenit SMG:[/b] A kinetic weapon that offers rapid-fire capabilities for close-quarters combat.
[*][b]TAS-9 Shotgun:[/b] Ideal for dealing heavy damage at short range.
[*][b]U9 Supra Handgun:[/b] A versatile weapon that balances power and precision.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/1493edd98a1e70e4d0924f05f83808045aeb62a8.png[/img]
[list][*][b]EZN-5 Plasma Rifle:[/b] Delivers powerful plasma shots, great for mid-range engagements.
[*][b]RM3 Grenade Launcher:[/b] Allows you to launch explosive grenades, perfect for crowd control.
[*][b]Striga HS-V Lightning Gun:[/b] Unleashes devastating high-damage lightning attacks at short range.[/list]
[list]Customize and upgrade these weapons to become the ultimate Hyper Unit. Using multiple weapons in your toolkit will help you adapt to different combat scenarios and maximize your effectiveness on the battlefield.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/73868c0989483fe6383c71cdaa99668324703047.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/1ed778d729528146ceee55ef4cf7277d5546a828.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/956bac58a6c898101d550e4e789260c3320d49b5.png[/img]
[list]Choose your path of evolution and become an unstoppable machine! In Metal Eden, you have three unique upgrade directions: Core Power – maximise strength and raw attack power, Core Ripping – dominate battles by ripping enemy cores, and Body Suit – enhance mobility and survivability on the battlefield. Create your playstyle by combining modules and unlocking new possibilities![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/5effe421eac5fdba633a9c510893cb092b157091.png[/img]
Stay tuned for more information about the weapons and other exciting features of METAL EDEN. Get ready to dive into the cybernetic warfare and become the ultimate Hyper Unit!

Are you ready to save the COREs and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN? Join the fight and experience the future of cybernetic warfare!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493131/1ed778d729528146ceee55ef4cf7277d5546a828.png[/img]
